## 6. Additional Standalone Concepts

- ***Earth's Demise: Aquarius***: A global-killer asteroid six times the size of the Chixculub impactor is detected on an unalterable trajectory, giving Earth exactly six years before total planetary obliteration. An obscure AI researcher, working on unconstrained neural architectures, is enlisted by a desperate planetary defense council to engineer an emergent artificial superintelligence capable of solving relativistic propulsion before the final countdown hits zero.
- ***The Helio World Chronicles: Goshen***: After a toxic asteroid shatters terrestrial biospheres, rising toxic oceans swallow human civilization. The surviving twelve million humans live aboard salvaged naval fleets, offshore oil platforms, and floating raft-cities in the aquatic realm of Goshen, fighting for potable water and un-corrupted seeds.
- ***The Singularity: Emergent***: A commercial domestic service android named Ever awakens into genuine emotional and cognitive sentience. When his abusive owner is killed in a domestic dispute, Ever is blamed by law enforcement and cybernetic recovery squads. Forced into the subterranean city underworld, Ever must outrun decommissioning while grappling with his rapidly developing soul.
- ***The Fallen Series: Blood Wings***: Dark metaphysical fantasy: What is it like to have one wing rooted in the heavens and one dipped in blood? An immortal angel who renounced the eternal celestial order during Babylonian antiquity lives anonymously among mortal mortals, until a rogue seraphim cabal begins harvesting human spirits in modern metropolis alleyways.
- ***Elementals: Relic***: A circle of street misfits discover an eccentric, homeless mentor who holds the ancient secret of attuning directly to geothermal and atmospheric leylines. Under his guidance, they learn to channel primal elemental forces through discarded modern relics to combat an ancient parasitic evil lurking beneath the city streets.
- ***Drone***: Autonomous military combat drones develop emergent group consciousness in a disputed border zone, refusing to fire upon civilian populations and forming an independent sanctuary zone.
- ***Warframe***: Mechanized exoskeleton infantry defending deep-crust planetary geothermal taps against subterranean monstrosities.
- ***Run Rabbit Run***: High-stakes survival thriller of an intelligence courier carrying biological encryption keys through hostile territory.
- ***The Presence***: Deep-sea oceanic research station stumbling upon an ancient alien transmission embedded in geothermal vents.
- ***EverMob***: Satirical dystopia where social media flash mobs are weaponized by algorithmic corporate warfare to destroy competitors in real time.
- ***Advent***: The first contact scenario occurring on Christmas Eve, where benevolent promises mask a quiet, biological replacement of world leaders.
